legacyBootstrap.reason: The Windows 10 compatibility target includes x64 client builds 17763 through 21999. WinGet remains optional for host support.

nonWindowsCli.platformScope: Keep the OS and package-manager filters in platform-detect.ps1 unchanged.

recovery.windows: Use Windows 10 x64 client version 1809 through 22H2 with an exact release/build pair listed here, or a listed Windows 11 Home or Pro x64 client release within its end-of-servicing date. Windows 10 Home and Pro reached Microsoft end of support on 2025-10-14; App Installer compatibility does not provide OS security updates.
recovery.engine: Use Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell Core 7.2.0 through 7.6.9 on a supported host. PowerShell Core 7.2 and other retired releases may no longer receive Microsoft security updates. The consent-gated provisioning plan installs the pinned PowerShell Core 7.6.9 release while its published support lifecycle remains active.
recovery.gui: Use the CLI entry point when Windows Forms or the required desktop runtime is unavailable.
